name: VolRec
definition: A volumetric reconstruction technique that generates full-resolution 3D volumes from lower-resolution acquired volumes by combining spatial interlace/interpolation with temporal interpolation using data from previous volumes.
summary: VolRec is a 4D spatiotemporal reconstruction technique that generates full-resolution 3D volumes from lower-resolution inputs by combining spatial interlace with temporal interpolation, enabling high-speed processing via GPU acceleration.
